typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AuditFolder as string (),
	Count as integer (),
	EmailRecipientFailure as string (),
	EmailRecipientSuccess as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EndDate_Adhoc as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	FTPFolder as string (),
	OutputFolder as string (),
	ProcessRunDate as timestamp (),
	RowCount as integer (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StartDate_Adhoc as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		{First Name} as string,
		{Request Type} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		{Activity ID} as string,
		{Original Transaction ID} as string,
		CRLF as string,
		MCOUniqueID as string,
		{Activity Reported Date} as string,
		{Activity Performed Date} as string,
		{Medicaid ID} as string,
		{Activity Source} as string,
		{Transaction ID} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @MAX_ROW INT SELECT @MAX_ROW = MAX([Transaction ID_SEQ]) FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.[EXTRACT].KY_My_Rewards_Extract with(nolock)  SELECT 		 CAST([Transaction ID_DDMMCCYY] + REPLACE(STR([Transaction ID_SEQ],7),SPACE(1),\'0\') AS CHAR(16)) AS [Transaction ID] 		,CAST([MCOUniqueID] AS CHAR(10)) AS [MCOUniqueID] 		,CAST([Activity Source] AS CHAR(8)) AS [Activity Source] 		,CAST([Medicaid ID] AS CHAR(11)) AS [Medicaid ID] 		,CAST([First Name] AS CHAR(40)) AS [First Name] 		,CAST([Last Name] AS CHAR(40)) AS [Last Name] 		,CAST([Activity ID] AS CHAR(10)) AS [Activity ID] 		,CAST([Request Type] AS CHAR(1)) AS [Request Type] 		,CAST([Activity Performed Date] AS CHAR(8)) AS [Activity Performed Date] 		,CAST([Activity Reported Date] AS CHAR(8)) AS [Activity Reported Date] 		,CAST([Original Transaction ID] AS CHAR(16)) AS [Original Transaction ID] 		,CHAR(13)+CHAR(10) AS [CRLF] FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.[EXTRACT].KY_My_Rewards_Extract WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [FileName] = ? AND [Transaction ID_SEQ] != @MAX_ROW ORDER BY 1 ASC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DataQuery
DataQuery sink(input(
		First_Name as string,
		Request_Type as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Activity_ID as string,
		Original_Transaction_ID as string,
		CRLF as string,
		MCOUniqueID as string,
		Activity_Reported_Date as string,
		Activity_Performed_Date as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		Activity_Source as string,
		Transaction_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		First_Name = {First Name},
		Request_Type = {Request Type},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		Activity_ID = {Activity ID},
		Original_Transaction_ID = {Original Transaction ID},
		CRLF,
		MCOUniqueID,
		Activity_Reported_Date = {Activity Reported Date},
		Activity_Performed_Date = {Activity Performed Date},
		Medicaid_ID = {Medicaid ID},
		Activity_Source = {Activity Source},
		Transaction_ID = {Transaction ID})) ~> WriteDetailRows
